about.title: Larkspur Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Larkspur is a small place. With about 12,417 residents tucked into Marin County, a death here is rarely anonymous — neighbors along Magnolia Avenue notice, and so do the people who commute each day on US-101 and Sir Francis Drake Boulevard. In 2025, public records show 39 injury collisions and 54 people hurt on Larkspur roads, with no traffic fatalities recorded that year. That fact is worth being honest about: not every wrongful death claim begins with a crash. Families also lose loved ones to unsafe premises, defective products, medical mistakes, and workplace accidents, and California law recognizes each of those as grounds for a civil action when someone's negligence played a part. LawProactive is not a law firm. We are a free service that listens to what happened and connects you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death cases on contingency. You decide whether to move forward. There is no fee unless there is a recovery, and no pressure while you grieve.

whyChoose.title: Why Larkspur Families Turn to LawProactive

items.title: Clarity on who may bring the claim
items.desc: California limits who has standing to file: a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children come first, followed by certain dependents and heirs. An attorney in our network can sort out where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: Deadlines handled early, not late
items.desc: Most wrongful death actions in California must be filed within two years of the date of death, and the window shrinks considerably when a government entity is involved. Getting connected promptly protects that timeline.

items.title: The full picture of your losses
items.desc: Recoverable losses reach beyond funeral and burial costs to the financial support your loved one would have provided and the loss of their love, companionship, and guidance. Your attorney will document each of these, not just the receipts.

items.question: Larkspur recorded no traffic deaths in 2025. Does that mean wrongful death cases don't really happen here?
items.answer: Not at all. The 2025 count reflects only traffic fatalities within city limits, while wrongful death claims arise from many other circumstances, including medical errors, unsafe property, defective products, and workplace incidents. Larkspur residents also travel daily on US-101 and Sir Francis Drake Boulevard into neighboring communities, where a fatal crash would not appear in Larkspur's own numbers. Where the death occurred matters for the claim, not where the family lives.

items.question: The driver who caused my father's death is facing criminal charges. Do we still need a civil case?
items.answer: Yes, they are separate matters. A criminal prosecution is brought by the state and focuses on punishment; it does not compensate your family for funeral costs, lost support, or the loss of his companionship. A wrongful death action is a civil claim your family brings, and it can move forward regardless of how the criminal case is resolved.

items.question: How long do we have to file, and does it change if a public agency was involved?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of death to file a wrongful death action. If a city, county, or state agency may share responsibility, a formal government claim must be presented much sooner, often within six months. Because that shorter window passes quickly during a period of grief, connecting with an attorney early is the safest course.
